domain-information: A receptionist records a new booking made by a guest for a certain room and duration.
A receptionist assigns an available room to a guest based on their booking details.
A receptionist informs housekeeping when a guest checks out so the room can be cleaned.
A receptionist registers a check in when a guest arrives and a check out when a guest departs.
A receptionist receives service requests form a guest.
A guest requests an additional service such as a city tour or spa appointment.
A guest checks in at the front desk and receives room access information.
A guest provides feedback about their stay to the receptionist.
A housekeeping supervisor reviews the daily cleaning schedule to assign rooms to cleaners.
A housekeeping supervisor checks the completion status of cleaned rooms.
A housekeeping supervisor reports any issues found during cleaning to the receptionist.
A room cleaner cleans assigned guest rooms according to the cleaning schedule.
A room cleaner marks the room status as ready once finished.

domain objects.name: Receptionist
domain objects.description: Handles guest bookings, check-ins, check-outs, and communication with housekeeping.

domain objects.name: Guest
domain objects.description: A hotel customer who books, stays, and requests services.

domain objects.name: Booking
domain objects.description: A reservation made by a guest for a specific room and duration.

domain objects.name: Room
domain objects.description: A hotel accommodation unit assigned to a booking or cleaning task.

domain objects.name: Duration
domain objects.description: The time span of a guest’s stay as defined in the booking.

domain objects.name: Service Request
domain objects.description: A request from a guest for an additional service or assistance.

domain objects.name: Check In
domain objects.description: The process of registering a guest’s arrival and granting room access.

domain objects.name: Room Access Information
domain objects.description: Details that allow a guest to access their assigned room, such as key code or card.

domain objects.name: Check Out
domain objects.description: The process of a guest’s departure and closing of their stay record.

domain objects.name: Feedback
domain objects.description: Guest comments or evaluations about their stay experience.

domain objects.name: Housekeeping Supervisor
domain objects.description: Oversees room cleaning, schedules tasks, and reports issues to reception.

domain objects.name: Cleaning Schedule
domain objects.description: A daily plan that assigns cleaners to specific rooms.

domain objects.name: Cleaner
domain objects.description: A staff member responsible for cleaning and preparing guest rooms.

domain objects.name: Completion Status
domain objects.description: Indicates whether a room is ready, occupied, or needs cleaning.

domain objects.name: Issue Report
domain objects.description: A note raised by housekeeping about room-related problems or maintenance needs.

associations.description: Guest makes a Booking for a stay.
Guest submits a Service Request during their stay.
Receptionist records and manages the Booking.
Service Request is received and processed by the Receptionist.
Guest provides Feedback after their stay.
Receptionist receives and logs Feedback from the Guest.
Receptionist performs the Check In process for a Guest.
Check In links the arriving Guest to their stay record.
Receptionist completes the Check Out procedure when the Guest departs.
Check Out finalizes the Guest’s stay and room release.
Receptionist informs Housekeeping Supervisor about room status changes.
Housekeeping Supervisor oversees cleaning and readiness of each Room.
Housekeeping Supervisor creates and manages the Cleaning Schedule.
Housekeeping Supervisor submits an Issue Report when problems are found.
Issue Report is sent to the Receptionist for further action or coordination.
